acceptance.interpretation: Quadratic and linear measured terms coexist with fixed model/optimizer state. PDF §9.2 explicitly accepts decomposition when asymptotic intervals do not apply. Raw slope flags are retained.

measured_interpretation.time: At largestL, descriptive forward fit fractions quadratic/linear/constant are [0.0, 0.26759832766252967, 0.7324016723374702]. Small fixed-width GPU calls are dominated by dispatch/synchronization and fixed overhead in this timing range. Nonmonotone raw times prevent a clean asymptotic quadratic-time validation; raw samples remain published.
measured_interpretation.memory: At largestL, descriptive memory fit fractions quadratic/linear/constant are [0.6671856103704545, 0.059012091849384773, 0.2738022977801607]. Explicit storage has a large L² component; efficient storage is predominantly fixed+linear. Total peak slopes are suppressed by the constant allocator/library/model/optimizer baseline.
measured_interpretation.formula_3_10: Attention products MAC=2B L²d perblock; QKV/output plusFFN MAC=8B Ld² forFFN2d. Their ratioL/(4d) ranges .125..2 on thisgrid. Arithmetic counts do not imply proportional walltime.
measured_interpretation.fit_limit: Three-term nonnegative regression is descriptive; five lengths cannot establish unique causal contributions or measure hardware utilization from coefficients.
